skipped.message: KNOWN GAP (reported, not fixed): Express sends 'X-Powered-By: Express', which tells attackers which framework to target. Fix: app.disable('x-powered-by') or helmet.
KNOWN GAP (reported, not fixed): CORS allows every origin ('*') by default. Fix: set CORS_ORIGIN in .env to the frontend's address.
KNOWN GAP (reported, not fixed): there is no rate limiting, so passwords can be guessed without limit. Fix: express-rate-limit on /api/auth/login.
KNOWN GAP (reported, not fixed): refused or failed money movements are not recorded; the 'failed' status exists in the schema but is never written.
